messages:
james: Heads up — planning an API v2 flip for Tue 2025-06-03 21:00 UTC. This thread is the ops checklist: release notes merge, tenant pinlist, and rollback triggers. Please ack if you have any client-impacting changes.

leo: ack. Merging release-notes/pr now. One quick question — header name stays `x-api-version` (current v1 uses `1`)?

maria: Confirming — we'll keep `x-api-version`. Prefer we require a strict `2` token from clients (no aliases).

claira: +1 on strict `2`. We'll ship SDK patch to accept `2` by EOD and publish a patch release note.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled deploy queued — id dbf-20250603-21. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Preflight checks: config parity OK, schema diff = 0.

sara: Can we set an automatic pause on canary if errors spike? Suggest: if error rate > 0.5% for 5m then pause rollout and notify on-call.

james: Yes — rollback/pause criteria: error rate >0.5% OR latency p95 > baseline +200ms OR spike in 4xx from client SDKs. Ops to confirm alert hooks and runbook commands.

leo: I added alert runbook entry to the ops playbook and wired the PagerDuty escalation. Quick note: streaming chunk framing changed (non-breaking at schema level but clients may see different chunks).

maria: Streaming chunk header changed from `transfer-encoding: chunked` to `stream-chunk` for internal framing. SDK will map it, but older clients without SDK update may mis-handle.

ops-bot: ops-bot: afternoon status — staging webhook test passed against v2 endpoint, auth unchanged. No regression seen in staging traffic.

claira: Release notes drafted: migration section (header change), SDK versions to upgrade, sample curl examples, and a runtime flag `REDWOOD_API_COMPAT=2` for local testing.

james: Pin policy: exclude tenants running `mobile-old-1.2.0` from the rollout for the first 24h. Deploybot should hold those tenants on v1 for safety.

deploybot: deploybot: tenant-exclude list applied (mobile-old-1.2.0). Canary start id stamped at 1795004321.

sara: Runbook sanity: rollback command is `./ops rollback dbf-20250603-21 --force`. Who will execute if triggered?

leo: I'll be on-call during the flip window and can execute rollback. If initiated, I'll run the rollback and post updates here.

maria: QA added a smoke set of 6 prompts to detect semantic drift and response shape changes. If mismatch >2% we'll treat as quality regression and pause rollout.

james: Final asks: docs team to publish the "v2 migration guide" by tomorrow morning. @maria @leo please review and sign off by 18:00 UTC. Also, ops — validate alert thresholds again before handoff.

everyone: :thumbsup:
